status: PROPOSED — owner approval is merging the amendment PR; freeze completes when this file's SHA-256 at the merged commit is recorded in docs/evidence/ace-builds-ace-v1.md per v1 spec section 9
amends: ace-builds-ace-harness-v1 — all v1 config values carry forward unchanged except the deltas below; v1 arm-A/B/C runs (PI8) remain reported under v1 and are never relabeled
dependency: arm C_prime requires PR #240 (the ambient trigger) merged before it can be registered, since C_prime installs the ambient hook into the arm session
billing_context: runs execute under the owner's Claude subscription, not metered API billing; no dollar cap is enforced; dollar figures are list-rate-equivalent accounting only

C_mid_tier_plus_ace.ace_surface: shipped-1.1-code-intelligence-only via the eleven-tool MCP surface (pull; the model must elect to call)
C_mid_tier_plus_ace.disposition: on subjects where the adoption comparison is measured, retained as the election control (evidence only); on other subjects, the production path as in v1
C_mid_tier_plus_ace.role: election baseline (arm C's PI8 value for code-intelligence consultation was ~0)

C_prime_mid_tier_ambient_ace.ace_surface: shipped-1.1-code-intelligence over the SAME backend as arm C, reached via the ambient hook (gated, fail-closed, auto-firing the journey on relevant turns) installed in the session config; differs from arm C in exactly this one pinned element
C_prime_mid_tier_ambient_ace.ambient_hook: ace_mcp_client.ambient_hook, pinned by commit; adds no MCP tool (ordinary governed HTTP call to /v1/code-intelligence/journey)
C_prime_mid_tier_ambient_ace.disposition: production path through ordinary review and merge on adoption-comparison subjects; the single arm whose output merges there (preserves v1 rule: only one implementation merges)
C_prime_mid_tier_ambient_ace.role: adoption-mechanism claim — ambient (push) vs election (pull), within-tier vs arm C

D_optional_exploratory.disposition: at most one subject, labeled exploratory, never in the comparative result; an optional D_prime ambient variant may pair under the same rule

pins.mcp_ace_arm: arm C: shipped eleven-tool ACE Code Intelligence surface only
pins.ambient_ace_arm: arm C_prime: the ambient hook auto-fires the journey; adds no MCP tool, the eleven-tool public surface stays fixed
pins.cost_enforcement: none — tokens and wall-clock are the caps
pins.cost_accounting: list-rate-equivalent USD from metered tokens at published list rates, reported only
pins.cross_tier_token_comparison: forbidden — different tokenizers; token/latency compared within tier only

adoption_comparison_subjects.policy: C and C_prime both run (C = election control, C_prime = ambient, C_prime merges) on at least PI9 and one of PI10 to get a two-point within-tier adoption series; owner confirms per-subject
adoption_comparison_subjects.timing: this amendment must freeze before PI10; if PR #240 is not merged by PI9 registration, either hold the v2 freeze or register C_prime only from the first subject after #240 merges (earlier subjects run under v1)

pre_freeze_slices.policy: retrospective annotation only, marked retrospective:true, excluded from the preregistered comparative result; unannotated gaps are valid and reported (v1 spec section 8.2)

subjects.registration: scope, acceptance criteria, repository heads, and answer key frozen before any arm runs

measures.code_intelligence_consultation_definitio: per arm-run: count of code-intelligence consultations and how many were load-bearing (resolved context the accepted change used). A consultation is an MCP-tool invocation (arm C / A-with-MCP) or an ambient-injection event (arm C_prime). Arm C's v1 PI8 value was 0; this makes the 0->N flip a first-class preregistered quantity. Load-bearing consultations reuse the v1 section 8 retrieval_shortcuts accounting

analysis.granularity: descriptive, per subject; no statistical claim
analysis.program_result: both per-subject tallies plus the section 8.1 curve projection; no aggregate score
analysis.negative_result_policy: valid outcome, ships in evidence, does not gate J1-J10
analysis.within_tier_verdict_C_vs_B: better: C improves majority of primary measures, materially worsens none; worse: inverse; mixed: else
analysis.tier_jump_verdict_C_vs_A: tier_jump: C matches or exceeds bare top-tier on majority of primary measures, materially worse on none; partial_lift: C beats bare mid-tier but short of top-tier; no_lift: else; quality measures only
analysis.adoption_mechanism_verdict_C_prime_vs_C: adopted_and_better: C_prime raises code-intelligence consultation above C's near-zero baseline AND improves a majority of the primary quality measures while materially worsening none; adopted_but_neutral: consultation rises but quality is unchanged (adoption was not the bottleneck); no_adoption: the ambient path did not raise consultation (hook/gate defect, recorded as such); worse: C_prime materially worsens a primary measure. Within-tier only; reported SEPARATELY from the unchanged C-vs-B and C-vs-A verdicts, which continue to use arm C for cross-tier comparability with the v1 series

exploratory_if: configuration differs from frozen digest, including agent version drift
second rerun after the single permitted rerun

experience_capture.contract: v1 spec section 8; a C_prime run appends the same record shape, its context_manifest_refs capturing the ambient injections' selection/omission receipts
experience_capture.retrieval_shortcut_events: first-class: retrieved item identity, work replaced, cycle-time saved in wall-clock and tokens
experience_capture.curve_projection: per-subject per-slice time series derived from capture records; reporting artifact, does not alter the per-subject tally
experience_capture.prior_slice_provenance: material-use receipt refs of earlier-slice beliefs; required for a point to count as compounding evidence
experience_capture.retrospective_flag: false for preregistered runs; true only for pre-freeze slice annotations

arm_order: B, then A, then C, then C_prime (D/D_prime last if run); the fixed order and its operator-learning limitation are disclosed per v1 spec section 2 rule 3, extended to the added ACE arm
operator: any model/session; registers subjects, launches fresh arm sessions, reviews, merges the sole merging arm, emits capture records; never authors mergeable subject code (v1 spec section 2 rule 7)
authority_parity: no arm — including C_prime — holds approve, merge, release, deploy, or promotion authority; the ambient hook only surfaces cited context, it activates nothing (v1 spec section 2 rule 6)
production_safety_valve: the merging ACE arm failing review beyond the single rerun is recorded honestly; production reverts to an ordinary non-arm implementation, disclosed; the experiment never blocks 1.2 delivery (v1 spec section 2 rule 8)
